summary.headline: Hindustan Zinc Q2 FY27 EBITDA hit a record INR9,285 crore (+108% YoY) at 62% margin, with net profit of INR6,412 crore; zinc COP guidance cut to $825-850/t.
summary.overview: Hindustan Zinc reported record Q2 FY27 results, with revenue from operations of INR15,093 crore (+77% YoY), EBITDA of INR9,285 crore and net profit of INR6,412 crore (+142% YoY). Mined metal output rose 5% YoY to a record Q2 and refined metal rose 7%, while zinc COP fell to $703/t (down 29%). Management revised full-year zinc COP guidance down sharply to $825-850/t from $975-1,000/t, partly offset by about $50/t of geopolitical cost escalation. Net cash closed at INR11,268 crore after free cash flow before growth capex of INR6,389 crore in the quarter.

segments.name: Zinc (mined and refined)
segments.commentary: Mined metal production up 5% YoY to a record Q2 output; refined metal up 7% YoY. Zinc COP $703/t in Q2 and $776/t for H1, both excluding royalty.

segments.name: Silver
segments.commentary: Saleable silver production rose 20% YoY to 173 tonnes in Q2 and is about 45% of H1 profitability. H1 silver output of 321 tonnes plus 20 tonnes sold in concentrate gives about 340 tonnes; FY27 guidance is 680 tonnes.

segments.name: Lead concentrate / by-products
segments.commentary: Sold 10 KT of lead concentrate in Q2 (about 6,000 t lead, 10 t silver) for revenue of about INR300 crore and profit of INR155 crore. Sulfuric acid by-product benefited COP but is auctioned and not guided.

guidance_outlook: Zinc COP guidance for FY27 revised to $825-850/t from $975-1,000/t; management expects Q3 broadly in line with Q2 levels.
FY27 silver production guidance maintained at 680 tonnes; H2 delivery expected to meet it.
FY28 silver output of 730-750 tonnes is a hope, subject to debottlenecking projects; to be finalised towards year-end.
FY27 capex outlook about INR5,000 crore, with higher spend in Q3 and Q4 as expansion progresses.
Management reiterated a 2x growth ambition and expects the 250 KTPA integrated zinc expansion and the 10 MTPA tailings reprocessing plant to stay on track.
capex_capacity: Q2 capex of about INR1,200 crore sustaining and about INR700 crore growth.
250 KTPA integrated zinc expansion: engineering and procurement almost complete; mine development underway.
10 MTPA tailings reprocessing plant progressing as per plan.
Four critical mineral blocks are mainly exploration; exploration to finish in Q3 FY29. Gundlupet REE and Yttrium block is under a executed mining lease, with resource indications in 2-3 years.
Q2 ore grade 7.6%. Domestic coal share of usage 32% in Q2.
demand_pricing: Management sees a 2026 refined zinc deficit of about 180 KT (demand 13.87 Mt vs supply 13.69 Mt), with the market tight over the next decade.
Silver expected to be in deficit for a sixth consecutive year in 2026, with a shortfall of about 1.44 thousand tonnes.
Zinc hedges: 40 KT for Q3 at INR3,476 and 36 KT for Q4 at INR3,698; silver hedge of 8 t for Q3 at $68/oz.
Sulfuric acid by-product prices were strong; FY26 sulfuric acid revenue was about INR1,000-1,200 crore per management, with no FY27 guidance given.

qa_highlights.question: What are the hedge quantities and rates by quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: 40 KT zinc hedged for Q3 at INR3,476 and 36 KT for Q4 at INR3,698; 8 t silver hedged for Q3 at $68/oz.

qa_highlights.question: Can COP go below the revised $825-850/t guidance given sulfuric acid strength?
qa_highlights.answer: Sulfuric acid gave a positive surprise, but geopolitical cost escalation added about $50/t; Q3 is expected broadly in the same range and FY guidance is kept at $825-850/t.

qa_highlights.question: Domestic coal share and Q2 capex split?
qa_highlights.answer: Domestic coal was 32% of usage. Q2 capex was about INR1,200 crore sustaining and about INR700 crore growth; FY capex about INR5,000 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Update on new critical mineral blocks?
qa_highlights.answer: Three of four are exploration blocks, with exploration finishing in Q3 FY29. The Gundlupet REE and Yttrium block has an executed mining lease, with resource and business plan indications in 2-3 years.

qa_highlights.question: Lead concentrate revenue, margin and plans?
qa_highlights.answer: Q2 sale of 10 KT gave about INR300 crore revenue and INR155 crore profit. No specific concentrate sales plan; sales depend on concentrate availability relative to smelter capacity.

qa_highlights.question: Silver guidance and FY28 outlook; sulfuric acid contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 silver guidance of 680 t is maintained (H1 about 340 t including concentrate). FY28 730-750 t is a hope pending debottlenecking. Management declined to guide on sulfuric acid, saying it is auctioned at market prices; FY26 contribution was about INR1,000-1,200 crore.

risks_watch: Zinc and silver prices and hedge roll-off: Q3-Q4 zinc hedges are at INR3,476-3,698, versus spot levels not disclosed.
Sulfuric acid by-product pricing, which lowers COP and is not guided.
Geopolitical energy and input cost escalation (about $50/t impact on COP).
Execution of the 250 KTPA expansion and tailings plant, with capex stepping up in H2.
FY28 silver target of 730-750 t depends on debottlenecking projects still in pipeline.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on results and cost leadership, with clear numeric guidance on COP and silver. Evasive on sulfuric acid, which management declined to quantify or guide, and non-committal on FY28 silver ("we can hope to do that") and concentrate sales plans.
key_quotes: Our zinc cost of production in second quarter FY27 stands at $703 per ton.
Our EBITDA stands at INR9,285 crores, and the net profit is at a record level of INR6,412 crores.
We can hope to do that. We have some of the debottlenecking projects in the pipeline.

10 MTPA tailings reprocessing plant (progressing as per plan)

growth.why: Q2 revenue +77% and EBITDA +108% YoY on lower COP and higher prices; management reiterates a 2x growth ambition with the 250 KTPA zinc expansion and 10 MTPA tailings plant on track, FY27 silver guidance of 680 t held, but no specific revenue growth % or capacity timeline was given.
